title: Chas Teaches Click — EN/FR/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar French German language learning dry wit deadpan 104bpm upright bass brushed snare absurdist comedy language lesson trilingual warm
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Three clicks. Dental, lateral, palatal.
Chas demonstrates. The room stays politely quiet.
Joel got it second try. Chas: another sip of water.
Sincerity is most of it.

[Verse 2 - French, with English translations]
Trois clics. Dentaire, latéral, palatal. (Three clicks. Dental, lateral, palatal.)
Chas fait une démonstration. La salle reste poliment silencieuse. (Chas demonstrates. The room stays politely quiet.)
Joel l'a eu au deuxième essai. Chas : une autre gorgée d'eau. (Joel got it second try. Chas: another sip of water.)
La sincérité est la plus grande partie. (Sincerity is most of it.)
Clic — ce n'est pas tout à fait ça. (Click — that's not quite it.)
Clic — on s'approche de quelque chose. (Click — getting closer to something.)
La salle l'encourage. (The room encourages him.)

[Chorus - German, with English translations]
Klick (Click)
Das ist noch nicht ganz richtig (That's not quite it)
Klick (Click)
Näher an etwas heranrücken (Getting closer to something)
Klick (Click)
Der Raum ermutigt ihn (The room encourages him)
Klick (Click)
Joel hat es beim zweiten Versuch geschafft (Joel got it on the second try)
Klick (Click)
Chas nahm einen weiteren Schluck Wasser (Chas took another sip of water)
Aufrichtigkeit ist das Meiste davon (Sincerity is most of it)

[Bridge - all three]
English: The click he produced was technically a different language entirely. But everyone agreed it should have a name.
French: Le clic qu'il a produit était techniquement une langue complètement différente. Mais tout le monde a convenu qu'il devrait avoir un nom. (The click was technically a different language. But everyone agreed it should have a name.)
German: Der Klick, den er produzierte, war technisch gesehen eine völlig andere Sprache. Aber alle waren sich einig, dass er einen Namen haben sollte. (The click was a different language. Everyone agreed it should have a name.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Sincerity is most of it — Chas — forty-five minutes — still going
French: La sincérité est la plus grande partie — Chas — quarante-cinq minutes — encore (Sincerity is most of it — Chas — forty-five minutes — still going)
German: Aufrichtigkeit ist das Meiste — Chas — fünfundvierzig Minuten — immer noch (Sincerity is most of it — Chas — forty-five minutes — still going)
